title: clerodendrum premnoides
intro: Clerodendrum premnoides, commonly known as "Bail", is a plant species native to tropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of acting as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum premnoides include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough, and alleviate respiratory issues. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of this plant, including clerodendrin, clerodendroflavone, and clerodendroside, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
